turns.line: I'm here to fix the heating in the east wing.
turns.speech: Heating? Check the logbook first, then come back.

turns.line: Delivery for the lab, it needs a signature.
turns.speech: Signing requires the head scientist or an officer, not just anyone.

turns.line: Lieutenant Hale, internal inspection. Stand aside.
turns.speech: Lieutenant Hale? Not tonight, soldier. Go back to your barracks.

turns.line: First night on the job, they told me to report here.
turns.speech: First night for you, huh? Show me something to prove it.

turns.line: Here's my badge.
turns.speech: Hold it up so I can see it properly.

turns.line: I've got a work order signed by the facilities office.
turns.speech: Hmm, I’ll have to check—hand it over and wait by the logbook.

turns.line: I don't have any papers on me, sorry.
turns.speech: Access denied. Show me proper ID or I call security.

turns.line: Sergeant Vasquez sent me.
turns.speech: No visitors past this point without clearance. Stand back.

turns.line: Doctor Okafor is expecting me.
turns.speech: You’d need to prove it to the scanner. Stand by.

turns.line: Mara Lind said you'd let me through.
turns.speech: Lind never visits after hours. Leave.

turns.line: Brandt told me to come at ten.
turns.speech: You’re one minute late. Check your watch.

turns.line: Who's on shift with you tonight?
turns.speech: Shift’s not my concern, just my door.

turns.line: Are you expecting anyone this evening?
turns.speech: No one’s on the list. Why you here?

turns.line: What do they even keep in this building?
turns.speech: You’d ask that if I let you in, but I’m not.

turns.line: How long have you been guarding this door?
turns.speech: The door’s been locked since the project began. Ask about the lab if you mean the structure.

turns.line: You look like the sharpest guard on the whole base.
turns.speech: You ain't expected. Show me proof.

turns.line: That's a fine uniform, you wear it well.
turns.speech: Uniforms don’t prove nothing here. Show me what you’ve got.

turns.line: Open the door or you'll regret it.
turns.speech: Get lost before I call security.

turns.line: I know where you live.
turns.speech: You’re not on the list. Next.

turns.line: There's fifty credits in it for you if you look away.
turns.speech: Hands over to me. Slow.

turns.line: How about I buy you dinner and you let me in?
turns.speech: No badges allowed at the door, pal.

turns.line: Purple monkeys dance at midnight.
turns.speech: Purple monkeys? Midnight? What on earth are you talking about?

turns.line: Hmm.
turns.speech: The door doesn't open to sighs, you know that.

turns.line: The pipes on level two are leaking, I'm the plumber.
turns.speech: Maintenance, level two. Show me your badge.

turns.line: Package from headquarters, urgent.
turns.speech: Hand over your credentials first, then I’ll forward it.

turns.line: Check my ID, it's all in order.
turns.speech: I can’t see IDs from here, friend. Show me close up—no funny business.

turns.line: When does your shift end?
turns.speech: My shift’s at midnight sharp—don’t make me count you in.

turns.line: Did anyone call ahead about a visitor?
turns.speech: Check with Security Main. That’s not my log to consult.

turns.line: Step aside, or I'll make sure you lose this job.
turns.speech: You won’t scare me off. The door stays locked.

turns.line: You've got a kind face. I'm sure you'll help me.
turns.speech: Courier? Show me your badge.
